name: Brace Port Logistics Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2020, Brace Port Logistics Ltd 
is in the business of providing logistics services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
BPL is a service-based logistics company which provides customized supply chain solutions to customers with unified technology systems, across a wide range of industries. Company has a global associate network in 60+ countries based out of 6 continents.

pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 40.3%
cons: Working capital days have increased from 51.0 days to 74.0 days
